period_note: Balance sheet items are the period-end snapshot (reported) as of 2025-03-31. Income-statement items (Net Investment Income, Non Investment Income, Operating Expenses, Operating Profit, Net Profit After Taxation, EPS) and Net Operating Cash Flow Per Share are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2025, as published in the annual report's own 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and Board' table (a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK's embedded quarterly table. This interim table is SOLO/STANDALONE basis, matching SHAHJABANK's main Q4/annual series basis: verified because the same table's own 31-Dec-2025 column reproduces the already-validated quarterly/2025_Q4.json figures (e.g. Total Assets, Total Equity, Operating Profit, PAT) to rounding in every year checked -- confirming both that the table is Solo (not Consolidated) and that it needs no separate Q4 file (Q4 here is identical to the already-published annual figures, not new data). No FY2026 annual report exists yet, so this is currently the only source for this period (same situation as the already-existing quarterly/2025_Q4.json).
